prompt: Parse the input as CSV (RFC 4180: comma delimiter, double-quote quoting, first row is the header). Ignore the 'row_id' column. Output a JSON array of objects with keys full_name, town, remark taken from the columns of the same names (all values strings, row order preserved). Output only the JSON.
notes: Equivalent of A-EXP-05: renamed headers, permuted order, injected row_id column to ignore.

prompt: The input is one JSON object. Flatten it: nested objects become dot-separated keys; array elements become key[i]; scalars are unchanged. Output the flat JSON object. Output only the JSON.
notes: Equivalent of A-EXP-09: renamed keys, reordered keys, rescaled numbers, injected debug subtree.

prompt: Parse one log line of space-separated key=value pairs; values may be double-quoted (quotes may contain spaces; no escapes inside quotes). Output a JSON object of all pairs (all values strings). Output only the JSON.

checks.input: request_id=abc severity=error account=bob text="disk full" timestamp=2026-10-05T12:00:00Z

notes: Equivalent of A-EXP-14: renamed keys, reordered pairs, injected noise pair (request_id).

prompt: Each input line has the form 'Record <id>: <date> (<note>)' where id and note are irrelevant. Convert the embedded date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD, one per output line, same order. Supported date forms: 'D Mon YYYY' (English month), 'YYYY/MM/DD'. Output only the converted dates.
notes: Equivalent of A-EXP-01: same dates embedded in record wrappers with irrelevant id/note.
